hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(FORCE_COLOR=0 node_modules/.bin/eslint --no-color "$f" 2>&1);; *.py) if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(FORCE_COLOR=0 ruff check "$f" 2>&1); else exit 0; fi;; *) exit 0;; esac; if [ -n "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then jq -n --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Lint output for edited file:\n"+$out)}}'; fi; }
